name: Exp_ColorMETRO_XRSX
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorMETRO_XRSX custom indicator, which uses a double smoothing algorithm with fast and slow step sizes to generate momentum-based signals. It opens buy positions when the fast metro line crosses above the slow line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing on signal reversals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorMETRO_XRSX进行交易，该指标使用双平滑算法配合快慢步长生成动量信号。当快线上穿慢线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorMETRO_XRSX指标的双线交叉动量系统，通过快慢两个步长的Metro指标线交叉判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当MPlus线上穿MMinus线时触发买入信号，当MPlus线下穿MMinus线时触发卖出信号，且仅在信号线发生交叉转换时才开仓（MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0]变更为MPlus[1]>MMinus[1]）。出场条件包括：信号反转时平仓（如持多仓时MPlus下穿MMinus则平多仓），以及固定的止损和止盈（默认止损1000点，止盈2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种资金管理模式：自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理采用MarginMode枚举，默认使用固定手数（LOT）模式，MM参数默认0.1，结合TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现仓位计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a dual-line crossover momentum system based on the ColorMETRO_XRSX indicator, which uses two Metro indicator lines with fast and slow step sizes to determine trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is triggered when the MPlus line crosses above the MMinus line, and a sell signal is triggered on the opposite crossover, with positions only opened when a signal transition occurs (MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0] changing to MPlus[1]>MMinus[1]). Exit conditions include: closing positions on signal reversal (e.g., closing a long when MPlus crosses below MMinus), and fixed stop loss and take profit levels (default SL 1000 points, TP 2000 points). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk ratio, supporting five money management modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MarginMode enum with a default of fixed lot (LOT) mode and MM parameter default of 0.1, implemented through functions in the TradeAlgorithms.mqh include file.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Trade share; negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price slippage deviation in points

pros: 双线交叉确认机制，仅在信号转换时开仓，避免频繁交易
支持多种资金管理模式和灵活的买卖开关，可精细控制交易行为
使用新K线检测（IsNewBar）避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
指标平滑方法可选（JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA等），适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Dual-line crossover confirmation mechanism only opens positions on signal transitions, avoiding frequent trading
Supports multiple money management modes and flexible buy/sell switches for fine-grained trade control
Uses new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated position opening within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Selectable smoothing methods (JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA etc.) adapt to different market conditions
cons: 止损默认1000点和止盈2000点过大，对于多数品种风险过高
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在不同信号上重复开仓导致过度暴露
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时仍可能开仓造成不利成交
依赖自定义指标文件，若ColorMETRO_XRSX指标未安装则EA无法运行
没有回撤控制或最大持仓限制，极端行情下可能造成重大损失
cons_en: Default SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points are excessively large, posing high risk for most instruments
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions on different signals leading to overexposure
Lacks spread filter, may still open positions when spread is wide causing unfavorable fills
Depends on custom indicator file; EA cannot run if ColorMETRO_XRSX indicator is not installed
No drawdown control or maximum position limit, which could cause significant losses in extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数限制，提升风险控制能力
增加移动止损或保本止损功能，保护已获利润
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate directional positions leading to overexposure
Add spread filter and maximum position count limit to improve risk control capability
Add trailing stop or breakeven stop functionality to protect realized profits

risk_points: 止损止盈点数过大（1000/2000），在波动性较低的品种上可能承受不必要的大幅亏损
缺乏持仓数量限制和回撤控制，连续信号可能导致过度开仓
没有点差过滤机制，高spread环境下交易成本不可控
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit values are very large (1000/2000 points), potentially suffering unnecessary large losses on low-volatility instruments
No position count limit or drawdown control, consecutive signals may lead to excessive position opening
No spread filter mechanism, trading costs are uncontrolled in high-spread environments
